title: Deterministic Scoring Engine — implementation
summary: Generate transparent, explainable, deterministic scores across seven policy outcome categories, with a configurable weighting system and per-score rationale. No AI anywhere in the scoring path. Tracks all implementation stories for this epic.
acceptance_criteria: All seven categories produce a deterministic score for a given model
Identical inputs always yield identical scores (verified by test)
Each score is accompanied by a human-readable rationale
Weightings are externally configurable and documented
No code path in scoring imports an AI provider
notes:
Scope (in): Categories: Fiscal Sustainability, Economic Growth, Poverty Reduction, Income Equality, NHS Demand Impact, Housing Affordability, Implementation Complexity; Configurable score-weighting system; Score rationale output; No AI dependency
Out of scope: AI-generated commentary on scores (EPIC-010); Cross-user ranking UI (EPIC-007); Distributional inputs to scoring (EPIC-013, later refinement)
